blocks.summary: For that warm, numbing Sichuan comfort hit late at night, these are Bengaluru's best-rated spots with confirmed Mapo Tofu/Paneer on the menu — ranked by how well they deliver the authentic ma-la kick and how late they stay open.

cards.title: Shang Palace, Vasanth Nagar
cards.why: Authentic Sichuan & Guangdong kitchen inside Shangri-La. Mapo Tofu and Sichuan pepper tofu are the standouts — nothing watered down for Indian palates.

cards.title: Bangalore Mandarin, Indiranagar
cards.why: One of the city's OG authentic Chinese joints. Mapo Tofu, Drums of Heaven, and burnt garlic noodles are the go-to orders. Fast service, family-friendly.

cards.why: Small-batch home-style Asian kitchen. Mapo Tofu is a confirmed hit per reviews, alongside char siu and Hainanese chicken rice. Closes early though.
